2607.14338.title: Beyond scalar losses: calibrating segmentation models via gradient vector field surgery
2607.14338.paper_summary: Region-based loss functions, such as the Dice loss, have established themselves as the de facto standard for highly class- and region-imbalanced segmentation tasks. However, models trained using region-based loss functions are notoriously miscalibrated and typically yield over-confident predictions. In medical imaging applications, such as defining tumor resection margins, this miscalibration is hindering clinical adoption. In this work, we outline a novel gradient perspective on this overconfidence and show how it affects region-based loss functions. We propose a "surgery" on the gradient vector field as a simple, yet effective intervention to mitigate calibration issues. This surgery adds a factor to the loss's partial derivative, scaling the gradient's magnitude linearly with the prediction error. In empirical evaluations across 2D and 3D medical segmentation tasks, we demonstrate the effectiveness of this intervention while maintaining high prediction accuracy when used in conjunction with any region-based loss function.
2607.14338.paper_summary_zh: 區域基礎損失函數，例如 Dice 損失，已經成為高度類別和區域不平衡分割任務的事實標準。然而，使用區域基礎損失函數訓練的模型以其明顯的錯誤校準而著稱，通常會產生過於自信的預測。在醫學影像應用中，例如定義腫瘤切除邊緣，這種錯誤校準正在阻礙臨床採用。在本研究中，我們概述了一種關於這種過度自信的新穎梯度視角，並展示了它如何影響區域基礎損失函數。我們提出對梯度向量場進行一種“手術”，作為一種簡單而有效的干預措施，以減輕校準問題。這種手術為損失的偏導數添加了一個因子，將梯度的大小與預測誤差線性縮放。在對 2D 和 3D 醫學分割任務的實證評估中，我們展示了這種干預的有效性，同時在與任何區域基礎損失函數結合使用時保持高預測準確性。
